blurb: Mowgli, the man-cub raised by wolves, learns the Law of the Jungle from Baloo and Bagheera.
source: Text: the three Mowgli stories from The Jungle Book by Rudyard Kipling (1894), from the Standard Ebooks edition, each split into two parts. Public domain.

streets.name: The Council Rock
streets.blurb: Father and Mother Wolf must bring the man-cub to the Pack Council — and the Pack must decide.
streets.how: Look at the clues around the Council Rock, then work out how Mowgli joins the Pack.

params.objective: Work out how Mowgli joins the Pack

clues.label: The Council Rock
clues.text: By the Law, cubs are brought to the Pack Council so the other wolves will know them. If there is a dispute, two who are not his parents must speak for him.

clues.label: Baloo
clues.text: Baloo, the sleepy brown bear who teaches the cubs the Law, grunts: “I speak for the man’s cub.”

clues.label: Bagheera
clues.text: Bagheera, the Black Panther, offers a fat bull, newly killed, as the price of the man-cub’s life.

solve.label: The Pack’s answer
solve.prompt: How is Mowgli accepted into the Pack?
options: Baloo speaks for him and Bagheera pays a bull, as the Law allows
Shere Khan agrees to let him stay
Mowgli fights the leader of the Pack
solve.hint: The Law says two must speak for a cub.

streets.name: The Red Flower
streets.blurb: The young wolves are turning against Mowgli, and Bagheera says he needs the Red Flower.
streets.how: Find the fire-pot and the dry branches, carefully, and bring them back to Bagheera.

params.label: found
params.objective: Find the fire-pot and dry branches

finale.say: Good. Keep the fire-pot safe, Little Brother. Now even the Pack will think twice.

streets.name: The Bandar-log
streets.blurb: The Monkey People snatch Mowgli and swing off with him through the treetops.
streets.how: Climb up through the treetops, branch to branch, the way the Bandar-log travel.

params.objective: Climb to the top of the treetops

streets.name: The Cold Lairs
streets.blurb: Baloo, Bagheera and Kaa the python race to the ruined city where the monkeys hold Mowgli.
streets.how: Race through the ruins of the Cold Lairs. Jump the broken walls and reach the summer-house where Mowgli is trapped.

streets.name: The Village
streets.blurb: Mowgli goes to live in the man-village, and becomes a herd-boy.
streets.how: Slip through the village to the grazing grounds without the villagers stopping you to stare.

skyRun.name: The Monkey Highways
skyRun.blurb: the Bandar-log’s highways, high in the treetops.
skyRun.how: Leap along the high branches. Some sway — wait for them!

npcs.name: Baloo
npcs.idle: The Law of the Jungle never orders anything without a reason.
npcs.thanks: Good! Now no snake, bird or beast will hurt thee.

steps.text: Talk to Baloo outside the Seeonee Hills.
steps.say: A man-cub must learn the Master Words for every kind of jungle people. I have hidden them round about — the word for the Birds, for the Snake People, and for the Hunting People. Find them!

items.name: The Master Word for the Birds
The Master Word for the Snake People
The Master Word for the Hunting People

steps.text: Say the Master Words to Baloo.
steps.say: “We be of one blood, ye and I.” Well said, Little Brother!

vault.name: Tiger! Tiger!
vault.blurb: an escape room about Mowgli’s last stand against Shere Khan — and why he belongs to neither world.
vault.intro: Shere Khan is waiting for Mowgli at the village gate. Plan the buffalo stampede, then answer the hardest question: where does Mowgli belong?

stations.label: The ravine
stations.lesson: A clever plan, with the herd and his wolf friends working together.

items: Gray Brother brings word that Shere Khan is in the ravine
Split the herd: bulls one way, cows the other
Take the bulls round in a big circle to the head of the ravine
Send the herd down the ravine
solve.hint: It starts with Gray Brother’s news.

stations.label: The Pack
stations.text: Match each friend to how they helped Mowgli.
stations.lesson: Mowgli’s friends came from both worlds.

pairs: Taught him the Law and the Master Words
Paid a bull for his life
Rescued him from the Cold Lairs
Took him into her hut in the village
solve.hint: Think back over all three stories.

stations.label: The water’s edge
stations.text: The young wolves said a man-cub had no place in the Pack. The villagers called him a sorcerer and drove him away. He goes off alone to hunt with his four brothers.
stations.lesson: Mowgli is part of both the jungle and the village — and fully at home in neither.

solve.prompt: Why does Mowgli belong to neither world?
options: The Pack sees a man, and the village sees a wolf
He wants to live in the Cold Lairs
He doesn’t like either of them
solve.hint: What did each side call him?

vault.openText: The way out opens onto the jungle.
vault.outro: Mowgli goes back to the Council Rock — and then away, to hunt alone with his four brothers.
